## Plugin reference

- Description: The browser extension's Wish section (BrowserExtension.Section 'wish'): wish's WishField under a 'Wish' title — the task composer with its own ↑, filing one task under Wishes and confirming inline — about the tab the popup was opened on (DraftPage: that tab's URL for the Page URL toggle, no element picker).
- Web:
  - Contributes: `BrowserExtension.Section` "Wish" → `ExtensionWishSection`
  - Uses:
    - `companions/browser-extension.BrowserExtension`
    - `companions/browser-extension.useExtensionHost`
    - `companions/panel.PanelSection`
    - `tasks/task-draft-form.DraftPage`
    - `tasks/task-draft-form.DraftPageProvider`
    - `wish.WishField`
